title: Delicate Vietnamese Pho
description: A traditional Vietnamese noodle soup with a delicate broth and tender pork.

ingredients.name: Pork bones
ingredients.notes: Beef or pork bones can be used

ingredients.name: Fresh herbs
ingredients.notes: Optional, such as basil, mint, or cilantro

instructions: 2. Place pork bones on a baking sheet and roast for 30 minutes.
3. In a large pot, combine ginger, onion, star anise, and cinnamon stick.
4. Add roasted pork bones, fish sauce, and soy sauce to the pot.
5. Pour in 4 cups of water and bring to a boil.
6. Reduce heat to low and simmer for 1 hour.
7. Strain the broth through a fine-mesh sieve into a clean pot.
8. Cook rice noodles according to package instructions.
9. Slice pork shoulder into thin strips.
10. Assemble pho by placing noodles in a bowl, adding sliced pork, and ladling hot broth over the top.
11. Garnish with bean sprouts, fresh herbs, and any desired toppings.
